input:
I need to print a claim summary for one of our policyholders — it’s for internal review and must include all payments, reserves, and attached supplier details, as per our audit protocol.
The user cannot easily generate a comprehensive claim summary with all required details.

they’re only pulling through one name, and it’s causing complaints
Joint policyholder letters only include one name, leading to complaints.

That’s reassuring. We’ve had too many delays from payment detail checking.
Delays occur because payment detail checking takes too long.

We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders.
Delays in claim payments occur because third‑party bank details cannot be verified in advance, leading to reissues and unhappy policyholders.

I’m trying to get our purchase order number updated on your latest invoice — it’s currently wrong and needs to reflect our internal tracking correctly.
The purchase order number on the invoice is incorrect.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble pulling up the latest reserves report for our marine cargo claims.
The user cannot retrieve the latest reserves report for marine cargo claims.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it?
The user cannot reset their password for the claims portal.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders.
The user cannot access the policyholders' documents section because they need to reset their password.

the reporting module doesn’t always sync the latest tasks with our policyholders’ records.
The reporting module fails to sync the latest tasks with policyholder records.

Definitely interested. We’ve been waiting for that feature to reduce manual work on reserves and supplier reconciliations.
The customer has to perform manual work on reserves and supplier reconciliations.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the latest supplier payment against our claims reserves and I’m not sure if I’m updating the figures correctly.
The user is uncertain whether they are correctly updating figures while reconciling a supplier payment against claims reserves.

Yes, the letters tab is greyed out too, and I can’t assign new tasks to my team since the roles aren’t syncing properly.
Roles are not syncing, causing the letters tab to be disabled and preventing task assignment to the team.

we’re setting up our new claims team and I’m already dreading the permissions setup — it’s so easy to miss a box and then someone gets locked out.
Setting up permissions is error‑prone and can lock users out.

Do you know if the printed version includes supplier details too, or just policyholder and reserve info?
Uncertainty about whether the printed claim summary includes supplier details.

We’ve got a lot of legacy processes to modernize.
The customer is dealing with many outdated legacy processes that need to be modernized.

Can you walk me through how to upload claims documents and assign them to the correct reserves?
The user does not know how to upload claim documents and link them to the appropriate reserves.

we’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time.
Inability to verify third‑party bank details before processing claims causes payment delays.

One thing we’ve struggled with is payment detail checking — it’s causing delays.
The customer has difficulty checking payment details, which creates delays.

The issue is we can’t copy access roles — each new user needs permissions manually assigned, and one mistake blocks them entirely.
Admins must manually assign permissions for every new user because access roles cannot be copied, and a single error blocks the user.

That’d be a huge help — our policyholders are starting to notice the delays.
Policyholders are noticing delays in claim processing.

We’re reviewing our annual spend with Keelwater and need clarity on how tiered pricing affects our claims volume this year... can you send me a breakdown of how your pricing tiers apply to our monthly claims volume?
The customer lacks clear information on how tiered pricing impacts their claims volume.

We’re under pressure to reduce delays in claims processing.
Delays in claims processing are causing pressure.

it’s taking forever to assign permissions. Each person needs a custom setup and I keep worrying I’ll miss something.
Assigning permissions for each new team member is slow and they fear missing a required setup.

we need payee account verification to prevent delays. It’s impacting our reserves and supplier reporting too.
The lack of payee account verification is causing payment delays that affect reserves and supplier reporting.

Claims: click "Open"...Claims: click "Save", rage x3
Users must repeatedly click Open and Save when handling claims, leading to frustration.

Sure — when we generate letters for policies with two named holders, the system only pulls through one name, sometimes the wrong one.
The system only includes one name—often the wrong one—when generating letters for policies that have two named holders.

we’re keen to streamline how we handle claims and documents across our team
The team’s current process for handling claims and related documents is inefficient.

Hi Bryn, we’ve got a repeat issue where letters sent to joint policyholders are only showing one name — it’s causing confusion and complaints from customers.
Letters to joint policyholders only display a single name, leading to confusion and complaints.

can we adjust the roles so our junior staff can’t initiate payments without approval? We’ve had a couple of close calls.
Junior staff can initiate payments without required approval, leading to risky situations.

I’ve pulled the supplier payments but the reserves still don’t align with what’s recorded.
Reserves do not match the recorded amounts despite pulling supplier payments.

We’re getting complaints because when there are joint ... policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes ... showing one or the wrong one
The system incorrectly merges joint policyholder names, showing only one or the wrong name.

Hi Bryn, I’m Nellin from Holloway Reach — we’ve got a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays.
Recurring delays due to third‑party payee account verification issues.

We’re planning to expand our policyholder letters automation next month — any tips on best practices?
The customer lacks guidance on how to effectively expand their policyholder letters automation.

I’ve been reviewing our active tasks and noticed quite a few that haven’t moved in months—could we get those bulk-closed to clean up the dashboard?
Stale tasks remain active for months, cluttering the dashboard.

We’re getting complaints because the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names, and customers are understandably upset.
The system fails to merge both policyholder names, showing only one name on joint policies.

Perfect. And while we’re at it, can you confirm whether the letters module supports custom templates for policyholder notifications?
Uncertainty about whether the letters module allows custom templates for policyholder notifications.

Administration: click "Permission", rage x5
Users become frustrated when trying to set permissions in the admin area.

That’s a relief — I’ve got a batch of supplier payments to process today and can’t afford delays.
The customer needs to process a batch of supplier payments quickly and cannot tolerate any delays.

Perfect. We also need clean integrations with our supplier portals — can your system pull in supplier data without breaking our existing reporting?
They need reliable integrations with supplier portals that won’t disrupt their current reporting.

Thanks — just let me know when you’ve got a fix or workaround.
The customer is waiting for a fix or workaround for a permission‑setup duplication issue.

Hi Alwen, thanks for jumping on this call — we’ve been struggling with some payment delays lately.
The customer is experiencing delays in receiving payments.

We’re struggling because we can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments — it forces us to reissue failed payments days later, which delays claims resolution for policyholders.
Inability to verify third‑party payee bank details before sending payments leads to failed payments and delayed claim resolution.

I’m trying to filter tasks by due date because we’ve got multiple claims coming up and I need to prioritize them before the next reporting cycle.
User cannot easily filter tasks by due date to prioritize multiple claims.

when we send payments to third parties, the bank info isn’t verified ahead of time... payment detail checking isn’t happening before funds go out, so we’re stuck reissuing failed payments days later
Bank information for third‑party payments is not verified before sending, causing delayed and failed payments.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
Saving reports causes repeated rage due to failures.

Perfect — we’ve had issues with permissions before. Can you show how roles are assigned during setup?
The customer is having trouble understanding how to assign roles during setup.

we’ve hit a snag with supplier payments again.
The customer is experiencing repeated issues with supplier payments.

we’re seeing a spike ... last month’s batch ... affecting ... SLAs
A sudden increase in complaints is causing SLA violations.

Appreciate that. We’re seeing delays because payee account verification isn’t done before payment dispatch.
Delays occur because payee account verification is not completed before payments are dispatched.

We’ve also noticed that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting our supplier timelines.
Payee account verification is not performed before releasing funds, causing re‑issuance delays.

can we adjust roles so only senior handlers see the integrations tab? It’s causing confusion.
Non-senior users can see the integrations tab, causing confusion.

Claim details: click "Next"...click "Save", rage x3
The user gets frustrated by having to click Save repeatedly while navigating claim details.

can we also confirm how reserves and payments will appear in our reporting? That’s critical for our policyholders.
Uncertainty about how reserves and payments will be displayed in reporting.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard anymore.
User cannot log into the claims dashboard because they forgot their password.

Appreciate you taking this seriously — we’ve had three complaints this month just because the joint policyholder names weren’t merged correctly.
Joint policyholder names are not merged correctly, leading to customer complaints.

Hi Bryn, we’re getting complaints again because letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing real friction with clients.
Letters sent to joint policyholders only display a single name, leading to client complaints and friction.

We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
Letters to joint policyholders only show one name, causing complaints.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to pull a full claim summary for a policyholder and need to print it out for our internal file — can you help me find where that’s configured?
The user cannot locate the configuration to print a full claim summary for a policyholder.

can we discuss how policyholders receive automated letters? Some aren’t getting them.
Some policyholders are not receiving the automated letters.

It’s mostly around third-party payments — we can’t verify bank details ahead of time, which causes bounces.
The team cannot verify third‑party bank details before payment, leading to bounced transactions.

I’ve been reviewing the claims workflow and need to clarify how reserves tie into supplier payments.
The user does not understand how reserves are connected to supplier payments within the claims workflow.

we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.
The purchase order reference on the latest invoice is incorrect, causing reconciliation problems.

Understood. Can you point me to the right team or form to submit this?
The customer doesn't know which team or form to use for submitting an administrative request.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble assigning roles to new team members on our claims dashboard.
The user cannot assign roles to new team members on the claims dashboard.
